one_line_description: Work OS where teams create and shape their own workflows
auth_methods_evidence: Monday.com supports API tokens (api_key) AND OAuth2. Nango lists OAUTH2, we originally found api_key — both correct. https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/authentication
self_serve_evidence: The docs mention a 'Getting started' section and API playground, suggesting developers can self-onboard without contacting sales.
buildability_rationale: Good documentation, broad API surface with GraphQL, self-serve access with free trial, and MCP server available.
agent_notes: The API uses GraphQL and has extensive documentation with MCP support. The docs mention a free trial but don't specify exact pricing tiers. [NANGO CROSS-CHECK: Nango lists OAUTH2. Updated to include both — Monday.com supports API tokens AND OAuth2.]
